subject.title: fix(zai): send user agent during endpoint detection

question: Should this PR require redacted live Z.AI Coding Plan endpoint-detection proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the credential gap for this narrow source-level fix?
rationale: The code path and tests support the fix shape, but external Z.AI behavior cannot be proven in this contributor environment without a Coding Plan key.

options.title: Require live endpoint proof
options.body: Wait for a contributor or maintainer to add redacted terminal output, logs, or an artifact showing endpoint detection selecting the Coding Plan endpoint after this change.

options.title: Accept the credential gap
options.body: Merge one canonical branch based on the reporter's live before-fix evidence plus the narrow source/test fix, with the proof gap documented.

recommendation.title: Require live endpoint proof
recommendation.body: Wait for a contributor or maintainer to add redacted terminal output, logs, or an artifact showing endpoint detection selecting the Coding Plan endpoint after this change.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the Z.AI endpoint auto-detection feature and is the clearest owner for accepting or requiring live proof on that onboarding contract.
